module.purpose: Defines the cell concept for TanStack Table core: CellContext and CoreCell interfaces plus a factory that constructs cell instances, wiring row/column/table and applying plugin features.
module.summary: This module is part of the table-core package and establishes the data structure representing a single table cell. It exports two TypeScript interfaces describing the context passed to cell renderers and the core shape of a cell object. The createCell factory function builds a cell by combining row, column, and table references, generating a stable ID, and providing getValue/renderValue accessors. The getContext method is memoized for performance. After construction, any registered table features can augment the cell via their createCell hook. This is foundational for cell rendering and value retrieval in the table.
module.businessContext: Serves the data grid / table UI domain. Enables consistent cell value access and rendering context. If it fails, tables cannot render cells or retrieve row/column data correctly.
functions: createCell (~L52-91): Constructs a cell instance linking row, column, table and applying feature hooks

mutationOfArg: Passes cell reference to table features which may mutate it via createCell hook

typeShapes.name: CoreCell
typeShapes.shape:
export interface CoreCell<TData extends RowData, TValue> {
  /**
   * The associated Column object for the cell.
   * @link [API Docs](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/api/core/cell#column)
   * @link [Guide](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/guide/cells)
   */
  column: Column<TData, TValue>
  /**
   * Returns the rendering context (or props) for cell-based components like cells and aggregated cells. Use these props with your framework's `flexRender` utility to render these using the template of your choice:
   * @link [API Docs](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/api/core/cell#getcontext)
   * @link [Guide](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/guide/cells)
   */
  getContext: () => CellContext<TData, TValue>
  /**
   * Returns the value for the cell, accessed via the associated column's accessor key or accessor function.
   * @link [API Docs](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/api/core/cell#getvalue)
   * @link [Guide](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/guide/cells)
   */
  getValue: CellContext<TData, TValue>['getValue']
  /**
   * The unique ID for the cell across the entire table.
   * @link [API Docs](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/api/core/cell#id)
   * @link [Guide](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/guide/cells)
   */
  id: string
  /**
   * Renders the value for a cell the same as `getValue`, but will return the `renderFallbackValue` if no value is found.
   * @link [API Docs](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/api/core/cell#rendervalue)
   * @link [Guide](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/guide/cells)
   */
  renderValue: CellContext<TData, TValue>['renderValue']
  /**
   * The associated Row object for the cell.
   * @link [API Docs](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/api/core/cell#row)
   * @link [Guide](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/guide/cells)
   */
  row: Row<TData>
}

import { RowData, Cell, Column, Row, Table } from '../types'
import { Getter, getMemoOptions, memo } from '../utils'

detail.name: createCell
detail.signature: export function createCell<TData extends RowData, TValue>(table: Table<TData>, row: Row<TData>, column: Column<TData, TValue>, columnId: string): Cell<TData, TValue>
preconditions: table is a Table instance with _features array and options
row is a Row instance with id and getValue method
column is a Column instance with id
columnId is a string key for row.getValue
postconditions: cell.getContext returns memoized object containing table, column, row, cell, getValue, renderValue
each feature in table._features with createCell defined is invoked with (cell, column, row, table)
invariants: cell.id is always concatenation of row.id and column.id with underscore
getContext memo dependency list is [table, column, row, cell]
edgeCases: cell.getValue() returning null/undefined causes renderValue to return table.options.renderFallbackValue
table._features empty results in no feature hooks called
feature.createCell may be undefined; optional chaining skips it
stateMutations: assigns properties on local cell object (id, row, column, getValue, renderValue, getContext)
passes cell to feature.createCell hooks which may mutate it
detail.summary: Creates a cell object that binds a row, column, and table, providing id, value accessors, and a memoized context, then runs table feature hooks to enhance the cell; returns the composed cell.
